requirement: A configured remote Worker has live Spring Integration subscribers before Kafka delivery begins.
rootCause: CpfBatchRemoteWorkerConfiguration declares IntegrationFlow beans but does not activate the Spring Integration infrastructure; the Worker Kafka listener starts and all six actual requests are sent to an unsubscribed DirectChannel.
physicalEvidence: Fresh R37 DLT ListenerExecutionFailedException -> MessageDeliveryException -> MessageDispatchingException: Dispatcher has no subscribers
